findings.text: non-blocking: test_dispatch_stores_every_entry compares the returned queued count with entries supplied to _pass and never reads persisted requests; returning the requested count while dropping queue writes leaves it green, so it cannot prove the persistence its name claims.

non-blocking: The default 1800-second timeout cannot complete the measured station population, whose authorized replay takes 2512.220987588167 seconds; the original timing measure remains unmet and must remain explicit in coordinator writeback.
